The company is involved in the supply of pharmaceutical preparations, such as finished dosage forms and active pharmaceutical ingredients; manufacture of fermentation-based pharmaceutical products; and manufacturing and marketing analytical, laboratory, and test and measuring instruments. It also engages in the marketing and distributing professional broadcast, video, and audio equipment; marketing of generic and veterinary formulations; provision of a portfolio of products, including oncology, fertility, women's healthcare, and other specialty therapeutic segments; and manufacturing and marketing of vitamin C coated products. Ambalal Sarabhai Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
stocks.desc: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd engages in the custom synthesis and manufacturing of specialty chemicals in India, Europe, Japan, Singapore, China, North America, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Life Science related Specialty Chemicals and Performance Material. The company offers life science related specialty chemicals, such as agro intermediates and agro active ingredients for the agrochemicals industry; anti-bacterial and ultraviolet protection intermediates and ingredients for the personal care industry; and intermediates and key starting materials for active pharmaceutical ingredients. It provides specialty monomers, ionomers, and oligomers for defence, aerospace, and semiconductors applications; niche molecules for the electronic ecosystem; and materials for backend and frontend semiconductor processes, including battery chemicals. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Surat, India.

stocks.name: Aryaman Financial Services Limited
stocks.desc: Aryaman Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides merchant banking services in India. The company is involved in the lead management and syndication of small and medium sized initial public offerings, follow-on public offerings, rights issues, composite issues, qualified institutional placements, preferential issues, foreign currency convertible bonds, American and global depositary receipts issues, private investment in public equity transactions, venture capital funding, and other types of fundraising. It also provides loan syndication and underwriting; M&A advisory, including buy-side and sell-side advisory services; and open offer management services. In addition, the company offers private equity advisory services; structured finance advisory services, including promoter and acquisition financing; and corporate finance advisory services, such as scheme of amalgamations, mergers, spin-off transactions, ESOP transactions, foreign remittance, and equity placements, etc.; and certification, opinion, and valuation services. Further, it offers stock and commodity broking services; and valuation and advisory services for foreign investments. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aryaman Financial Services Limited is a subsidiary of Mahshri Enterprises Pvt. Ltd.

stocks.name: Aditya Vision Limited
stocks.desc: Aditya Vision Limited engages in the retail business of consumer durables and electronics in India. The company sells digital gadgets, such as mobile phones, laptops, and tablets; entertainment solutions, including televisions, sound bars, home theaters, cameras, and accessories; home appliances comprising air conditioners, air coolers, refrigerators, and washing machines. It also offers small appliances/cooking and kitchen appliances, including chimneys, air fryers, soup makers, cooktops, and dishwashers, as well as mobility and IT products. Aditya Vision Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Patna, India.

stocks.name: Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited
stocks.desc: Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited provides consultancy and support services in India and internationally. The company offers geological exploration and drilling, project planning and design, engineering, research and development, laboratory, environmental, information technology, human resource development, and specialised services, including geomatics including remote Sensing, ventilation and gas survey in mines, controlled blasting, performance evaluation of new explosives, mining electronics, mine capacity assessment, mine support design, rock mass rating non-destructive testing, management system consultancy, and measurement of coal and OBR. It also provides coal preparation, management, infrastructure civil engineering, and contract management cell services. Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Ranchi, India. Central Mine Planning and Design Institute Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.

stocks.name: Cochin Shipyard Limited
stocks.desc: Cochin Shipyard Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the building and repair of ships and offshore structures in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Shipbuilding and Ship Repair. It offers shipbuilding products, including aircraft carriers, missile vessels, anti-submarine warfare shallow water crafts, technology demonstration vessels, floating border outpost vessels, fast patrol vessels, hydrographic survey vessels, offshore patrol vessels, and pollution control vessels for the defence market; oil tankers, bulk carriers, dredgers, pax vessels, tugs, special purpose vessels, deck cargo/jacket launch barges, electric autonomous vessels and passenger ferries, ro-pax vessels, specialised fishing vessels, marine ambulances, zero emission feeder container vessels, and commissioning and hybrid operation vessels for the commercial market; and platform supply vessels and anchor handling/tug supply vessels for the offshore market, as well as product carriers, passenger vessels, high bollard pull tugs, and air defence ships. The company also provides ship repair services, such as maintenance and repair of aircraft carriers and other defense vessels, as well as tankers, bulk carriers, and other commercial and specialized vessels; oil rig upgradation, repair projects, and conversion services; and upgradation of ships for oil exploration, periodical maintenance, and life extension services. In addition, the company offers marine engineering training services. It exports its products in the United Arab Emirates, Bahamas, Cyprus, Germany, Saudi Arabia, the Netherlands, Norway, the United States, and Liberia. Cochin Shipyard Limited was founded in 1969 and is based in Ernakulam, India.

stocks.name: 63 moons technologies limited
stocks.desc: 63 moons technologies limited provides software solutions in India and internationally. It operates through Software Services/Solutions, Trading, and Others segments. The company offers DOME, an online trading software; POWERARMS, an electronic trading, risk management, and clearing and settlement platform; FOVEA for risk management; TRADEDART, a web-based trading platform; MARKETXSTREAM for analytics and quantification; CNS, a clearing and settlement application; DMATS, a depository for multi asset transaction systems; and Risk Management system, as well as Riskalculator to automate data collection; and DataCollector, a web-based electronic data submission and report generating systems. It also provides cyber security solutions, including risk assessments penetration testing and incident response; and QILegal, an AI-powered legal tech solution. In addition, the company offers trading, procurement, process management, risk consultancy, shared business support, IT infrastructure sharing, NBFC, Internet telecommunication, training and certification, and franchise services. It serves the banking, insurance, and capital market sectors. The company was formerly known as Financial Technologies (India) Limited and changed its name to 63 moons technologies limited in May 2016. 63 moons technologies limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: ABB India Limited
stocks.desc: ABB India Limited develops and sells products and system solutions to utilities, industries, channel partners, and original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally. It operates through Motion, Robotics and Discrete Automation, Electrification, and Process Automation segments. The Motion segment offers motors, generators, and drives that provide power, motion, and control for a range of automation applications, as well as solutions and related services. The Robotics and Discrete Automation segment provides value-added solutions in robotics, machine, and factory automation. The Electrification segment offers a range of digital and connected solutions for low- and medium-voltage applications, including EV infrastructure, solar inverters, modular substations, distribution automation, power protection, wiring accessories, switchgear, enclosures, cabling, sensing, and control. The Process Automation segment provides products, systems, and services, such as turnkey engineering, control systems, measurement products, life cycle services, outsourced maintenance, and industry specific products for the optimization of the productivity of industrial processes in oil and gas, power, chemicals and pharmaceuticals, pulp and paper, metals and minerals, marine, and turbocharging industries. The company was formerly known as ABB Limited and changed its name to ABB India Limited in June 2013. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. ABB India Limited operates as a subsidiary of ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.

stocks.name: Adani Energy Solutions Limited
stocks.desc: Adani Energy Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, generates, transmits, and distributes power in India. It operates through the Transmission; Distribution; Smart Meter; Trading; and Others segments. The company is involved in the establishment, commission, setting up, operation, and maintenance of electric power transmission systems; development, ownership, and operation of transmission lines; trade of bullion and other commodities; and laying of optical ground wire fibers on transmission lines to telecom solutions to telecom companies, internet service providers, and long-distance communication operators. It also provides electricity meters to optimize real-time insights of electricity usage. The company was formerly known as Adani Transmission Limited and changed its name to Adani Energy Solutions Limited in July 2023. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. Adani Energy Solutions Limited operates as a subsidiary of S.B. Adani Family Trust.

stocks.name: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited
stocks.desc: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products in India. The company operates through Sugar, Distillery, Co-generation, and Others segments. It offers molasses, bagasse, and press-mud products. In addition, the company provides industrial spirits, including ethanol and fusel oils. Further, the company is involved in generation and transmission of power, as well as trading of petroleum products. Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

stocks.name: Azad India Mobility Limited
stocks.desc: Azad India Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiary, NAE Mobility Private Limited, manufactures, assembles, and trades in electric buses and coaches in India. It offers luxury, airport tarmac, special purpose, OEM, school, and STU buses, as well as city e-buses. The company was formerly known as Indian Bright Steel Company Limited and changed its name to Azad India Mobility Limited in May 2024. Azad India Mobility Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Batliboi Limited
stocks.desc: Batliboi Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades machine tools and textile engineering machines in India and internationally. The company is involved in machine tools, air engineering, textile machinery, environmental engineering, wind energy, motors, international marketing, and logistics business. It also engages in the design, manufacture, sale, and service of gantry drilling and milling machines for energy, heat transfer, steel service, industrial machinery manufacturers, and job shop manufacturing sectors. In addition, the company is involved in the business of water effluent treatment plants and zero liquid discharge for industries. Batliboi Limited was founded in 1892 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Bluspring Enterprises Limited
stocks.desc: Bluspring Enterprises Limited provides integrated facility management, security, food catering, telecom network, and client asset management services in India, Singapore, and internationally. It offers soft and hard services, pest control and landscaping, on-site and central kitchen, and event catering services. It also provides telecom and industrial services, such as installation and commissioning, digital consulting, network deployment, architecture and assurance, and tower infra management; and security services comprising manned guarding, electronic surveillance, background verification and training, and other services, as well as catering services. In addition, the company operates Foundit, an AI-powered talent and recruitment platform; and provision of candidate and recruiter services. Bluspring Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 2024 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: Borosil Limited
stocks.desc: Borosil Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in consumer ware products in India. The company offers laboratory glassware, including beakers, bottles, burettes, cones, condensers, cylinders, dessiciators, dishes, distilling apparatus, flasks, funnels, funnels, filtration assembly, volumetric flask, gas generator, jars, kettles, pipettes, tubes, HPLC VIALS, microscope slides, and lab accessories, as well as pharmaceutical packaging. It also provides consumer products, such as glass serve wear products, opalware dinner sets, kitchen appliances, storage products, glass lunch boxes, and stainless-steel vacuum insulated flasks and bottles, as well as solar glass. In addition, the company offers home decor, gas stoves, fine optical table wear, stainless-steel cookware, pressure cookers, kadai, frying pans, vacuum-insulated flasks. It provides its products under the Larah, LabQuest, and Borosil brand names. The company distributes through traditional crockery stores, modern retail outlets, e-commerce and quick commerce platforms, and website. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hopewell Tableware Limited. Borosil Limited was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

stocks.name: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited
stocks.desc: Bosch Home Comfort India Limited manufactures and distributes air conditioners, chillers, refrigerators, air purifiers, and variable refrigerant flow systems in India and internationally. It operates through Cooling Products for Comfort and Commercial Use; and Design and Development Services segments. The company offers inverter and non-inverter, fixed speed, split, non-inverter, hot and cold, packaged, window, and cassette air conditioners (AC); ducted and ductless air conditioners; centralized AC and room AC controllers; and water- and air-cooled screw chillers, and centrifugal chillers, as well as air quality solutions, and AC apps and controllers. It also provides wall mounted inverter and non-inverter AC; cassette AC; VRF systems; and after-sales services. It offers its products under the Hitachi brand for residential and commercial use. The company was formerly known as Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited and changed its name to Bosch Home Comfort India Limited in November 2025. Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kadi, India. Johnson Controls-Hitachi Air Conditioning India Limited operates as a subsidiary of JCHAC India Holdco Limited.

stocks.name: Bright Brothers Limited
stocks.desc: Bright Brothers Limited manufactures and markets injection moulded plastic products for supplying to original equipment manufacturers for consumer durables industry in India. It offers composites, such as fiber reinforced polymer (FRP) and glass reinforced polymer (GRP); injection moulding, and extrusion moulding solutions, as well as provides paint shop services. In addition, it markets its products under the Brite brand for material handling crates; and hair brushes and beauty products under the DIVO brand name. Further, the company provides services, such as assembly services, surface finishing, ultrasonic & spin welding. It serves the home appliances and white goods, automotive and electric vehicles, fast-moving electrical goods, HVAC, railways, and electrical meters. Bright Brothers Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Barak Valley Cements Limited
stocks.desc: Barak Valley Cements Limited manufactures and sells cement and allied products in India. The company offers ordinary portland cement and portland pozzolana cement under the Valley Strong Cement brand name. It is also involved in mining limestone; and generation of electricity. The company serves individuals, contractors, builders, institutions, and government agencies. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: CESC Limited
stocks.desc: CESC Limited, an integrated electrical utility company, engages in the generation and distribution of electricity in India. It owns and operates two thermal power plants, including Budge Budge generating station with a generating capacity of 750 megawatts and Southern generating stations with a generating capacity of 135 megawatts; a 40-megawatt atmospheric fluidized bed combustion power plant in Asansol, West Bengal; a 300-megawatt solar project in Bhadla, Rajasthan; and a 450-megawatt hybrid project that consists of a 150-megawatt solar unit in Bikaner, Rajasthan and a 300-megawatt wind unit in Ananthapuram, Andhra Pradesh. The company serves domestic, industrial, commercial, government agencies, pumping stations, local bodies, schools etc. CESC Limited was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

stocks.name: Aarti Pharmalabs Limited
stocks.desc: Aarti Pharmalabs Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, pharmaceutical intermediates, and xanthine derivatives in India and internationally. The company offers active pharmaceutical ingredients for various therapeutic areas, such as cardiovascular, anti-asthmatic, anti-cancer, anti-coagulant, anti-diabetic, arthritis, central nervous system agent, skincare, overactive bladder, calcimimetic, decongestant, anti-thalassaemic, analgesic, ophthalmologic, antidepressant medications. It also provides contract development and manufacturing services for drug substance projects. In addition, the company offers intermediates, such as xanthine derivatives, including caffeine, theophylline anhydrous, aminophylline, etophylline, and theophylline; and acid and allied products, including sulphuric acid, sulphur trioxide, oil, dimethyl sulphate, diethyl sulphate, and sodium vinyl sulfonate. It serves pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and beverage industries. The company was formerly known as Aarti Organics Limited. Aarti Pharmalabs Limited was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: ABC Industries India Limited
stocks.desc: ABC Industries India Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of cotton yarns and knitted fabrics in India. It also offers cotton seed oil, mustard oil, and oil cakes. ABC Industries India Limited was formerly known as A B Cotspin India Limited and changed its name to ABC Industries India Limited in October 2026. ABC Industries India Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Faridkot, India.

stocks.name: Archean Chemical Industries Limited
stocks.desc: Archean Chemical Industries Limited manufactures and sells specialty marine chemicals in India and internationally. It offers bromine for use in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, flame retardants, and water treatment products, as well as oil and gas, and energy storage industries; industrial salt for chloralkali chemical, food and beverage, water treatment, and oil and gas industries; and sulphate of potash, an inorganic salt for use as a water-soluble fertiliser in agricultural applications. Archean Chemical Industries Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited
stocks.desc: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in investment, trading, and lending activities in India. It operates through the Investment Activity, Lending Activity, Rental Business, and ARC segments. The company is involved in investment and trading in shares and securities. It also invests in publicly listed and unlisted companies. In addition, it offers a range of credit and financing solutions, as well as engages in credit business. The company was formerly known as Pentium Investments and Infrastructures Limited and changed its name to Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited. Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: A. K. Capital Services Limited
stocks.desc: A. K. Capital Services Limited provides merchant banking services in India. The company offers investment banking products and services, including private placement of bonds/non-convertible debentures (NCDs) and commercial papers, public issue of bonds and NCDs, placement of masala bonds, loan syndication, underwriting of debt issues, qualified institutional placements, and foreign institutional reach. It also provides broking and distribution services, such as institutional and HNI stockbroking, wholesale debt market operations in G-SEC and corporate bonds, and depository services; and financing services, which include project financing, SME financing, real estate funding, and asset-backed funding. In addition, the company offers structured finance products, such as hybrid debt financial products, including perpetual and subordinate bonds, preference shares, and OCDS and FCCBS, corporate debt restructuring, structured financing, asset-backed securities and receivables securitization, fund-raising for INVIT and REIT, and offshore debt financing services. Further, the company provides portfolio management services, private wealth management, asset management, investment advisory, and research-backed investment solutions. Additionally, it offers knowledge services for debt basics, Indian debt market, market practices, monetary policy terminologies, and budget announcements and foreign portfolio investments. A. K. Capital Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited
stocks.desc: Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited manufactures and supplies amines, amine derivatives, and other specialty chemicals in India and internationally. The company offers aliphatic amines, such as methylamines, ethylamines, isopropylamines, n-propylamines, n-butylamines, ethylhexylamines, furfurylamines, n-propylamines, and cyclohexylamines; and amine derivatives, including dimethylamine hydrochloride, diethylamine hydrochloride, triethylamine hydrochloride, dimethylaminopropylamine, 3-ethoxy propylamine, 3-(methylaminopropyl) amine, dimethylaminopropylamine, 3-(2-ethylhexyloxy) propylamine, n-methylbenzylamine, diisopropyl ethylamine, diethylhydroxylamine, diethyl toluamide, and diethylphenyl acetamide. It also provides specialty chemicals comprising acetonitrile, 1,8-diazabicyclo[5.4.0]undec-7-ene, diethylketone/3-pentanone, alchan 100, alchan 300, 2-aminoethoxy ethanol, 2-ethoxy ethylamine, dimethylpropyleneurea, tetramethyl ethylenediamine, monomethylamine, and tempo free radical. The company serves pharmaceutical, agro-chemicals, water treatment chemicals, rubber chemicals, and other industries. Alkyl Amines Chemicals Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited
stocks.desc: Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited engages in the trading in shares in India. The company invests in equity, debentures, bond, mutual funds, etc. It also offers financial and derivative services; and engages in investment activities. Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Noida, India.

stocks.name: Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited
stocks.desc: Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and related activities in India. It is involved in the construction of residential and commercial complexes and IT parks. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Arkade Developers Limited
stocks.desc: Arkade Developers Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. It engages in the identification and acquisition of land, as well as the planning, execution, construction, and marketing of commercial and residential projects. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Avalon Technologies Limited
stocks.desc: Avalon Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated electronic manufacturing services in India, the United States, and internationally. It offers printed circuit board assemblies; custom cables and wire harness assemblies; magnetic assemblies; sheet metal fabrication and assemblies, as well as contract services; aerospace sheet metal fabrication; precision injection molding for plastic parts; new product introduction, including prototype building services; design for manufacturing implementation; product engineering; volume production; life cycle management; system integration; machining; and supply chain and logistics. The company also provides electro-mechanical systems and racks; box builds for railway signaling systems; machined components for aerospace, such as aircraft seating, cargo systems, smoke detectors, and engine components; precision-machined components for specialized locomotive systems; and magnetic components, including transformers, inductors, and chokes. It serves the clean energy, mobility, healthcare, semiconductor equipment, communication, and industrial sectors. Avalon Technologies Limited was founded in 1995 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Avantel Limited
stocks.desc: Avantel Limited engages in the manufacturing of wireless communications products in India. The company offers software defined radios; satellite communication equipment; HF communication equipment; radar systems; network management systems and application software; and embedded systems and digital signal processing solutions. It also provides mobile satellite services (MSS) network that offers voice and data communications to ships, submarines, aircraft, and Helios; UHF SATCOM network; wind profile radars; real-time information system for Indian railways; Sahayak; ERM-SAT systems; solutions for ocean gauges and tide gauge applications; and visual databases for aircraft simulators. In addition, the company offers RF test equipment, such as ADS, EMDS, ACAD, SOLID WORKS CADSTAR, digital transmission analyzers, logic analyzer, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators and analyzers, radio communication test sets, signal generators, high power test and measuring instruments, and BER testers; and testing and assembly facilities. Further, it provides engineering facilities, including CNC vertical machining centers, CNC turning lathe machines, drill tap machines, painting and chromatisation, 3D printing facility, wire cutting machines, wire drilling machines, injection molding facilities, surface grinding machines, and cylindrical grinding machines, as well as soldering, wire harness, and potting facilities. Additionally, it manufactures and sells health care products. Avantel Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

stocks.name: Awfis Space Solutions Limited
stocks.desc: Awfis Space Solutions Limited provides flexible workspace solutions in India. The company operates through the Co-Working Space on Rent and Allied Services, Construction and Fit-Out Projects, and Other Services segments. It provides co-working solutions under the Awfis and Awfis Gold brand names, as well as enterprise workspace solutions comprising design, construction, and management. The company also offers mobility solutions, such as meeting rooms that are equipped with internet connectivity, audio and video conferencing facilities, and other amenities; day passes, which provides temporary access to workspaces; and Virtual Office and Virtual Office Plus that provide business location addresses and package handling services, as well as training rooms. In addition, it provides design and build solutions for developing centers and external commercial offices. The company was formerly knowns as Awfis Space Solutions Private Limited and changed its name to Awfis Space Solutions Limited. Awfis Space Solutions Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Indef Manufacturing Limited
stocks.desc: Indef Manufacturing Limited provides material handling solutions in India. It also manufactures, sells, distributes and markets mechanical hoists, ergonomic handling solutions, overhead crane, EOT crane, electric chain hoists and wire rope hoists, stackers, and storage and retrieval solutions. The company also offers chain pulley blocks and ratchet lever hoists, as well as electric chain hoists and electric wire rope hoists; electric overhead travelling (EOT) cranes, gantry cranes, jib cranes, and light profile cranes; and floor-operated stackers and roll-out racks under Bajaj Indef, iCrane, and iStacker brands. The company serves oil and gas, engineering, auto and auto ancillary, cement, metals, and other industries. Indef Manufacturing Limited was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Aarti Industries Limited
stocks.desc: Aarti Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and dealing in specialty chemicals and intermediates in India and internationally. The company offers chemistry products, such as alkylation, ammonolysis, balz schiemann, bromination, chlorination, condensation, denitrochlorination, diazotization, dinitro chlorination, esterification, fluorination, grignard's reagent, halex, hydrogenation, hydrolysis, neutralization, nitration, oxidation, photochlorination, and propylation. It provides its products for acid, agrochemicals, API, dyes, fertilizers, metal and mining, miscellaneous, other, pharma, plasticizer, polymers, PU/epoxy, refinery and oil, field chemicals, thermal paper, and UV absorbers end use. Aarti Industries Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: A B Infrabuild Limited
stocks.desc: A B Infrabuild Limited engages in the civil construction business in India. The company is involved in the construction, alter, enhance, maintain, enlarge, pull down, remove, replace and develop, work, and manage of roads, railways, branches and sidings, and bridges. It also undertakes repair and petty road works and renovation and reconstruction work of slum areas. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: ABM Knowledgeware Limited
stocks.desc: ABM Knowledgeware Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides e-governance information security, technology-enabled applications through cloud services, and other software services in India. It also provides cloud-based security-as-a-service solutions that enable mobile and remote workforces to securely access corporate applications, email, and web resources from any device, over any network, and from any location. ABM Knowledgeware Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited
stocks.desc: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited operates as renewable energy and infrastructure company and is engages in the engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), manufacturing, and operation of integrated clean energy assets. Its services include ingot manufacturing, silicon wafer manufacturing, solar cell manufacturing, and solar panel manufacturing. The company also manufactures and sells cuprous chloride, cupric chloride, and copper sulphate in India and internationally. It also provides cupric chloride anhydrous and dihydrate, and copper phthalocyanine blue. The company's products are used in dyes and pigments, paint, pharmaceuticals, electroplating, metal extraction and ink, carbon paper, and PVC pipe coating industries. Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited was formerly known as Sanginita Chemicals Limited and changed its name to Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited in August 2026. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Gandhinagar, India. Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited operates as a subsidiary of B N G Investment LLC.

stocks.name: Asian Star Company Limited
stocks.desc: Asian Star Company Limited manufactures and sells diamond jewelry worldwide. It operates through two segments, Diamonds and Jewellery. The company provides generic, certified, mine-origin programme, and special-cut diamonds. In addition, it offers cocktail, European fashion, Indian fashion, men's, petite bridals, wedding, and ceramic indulgence jewellery. Further, it provides various cut and polished diamonds, and diamond studded jewelry. The company retails diamond jewelry through its jewellery boutique. Asian Star Company Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Banaras Beads Limited
stocks.desc: Banaras Beads Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of glass beads, necklaces, imitation jewelry, and accessories under the De-Lemon brand in India, the United States, South Africa, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers beads made from clay, brass, aluminum, copper, resin, ceramics, horn, bone, semiprecious stones, agate, lac, hand painted beads, and spray-painted beads. The company also trades in leather and cotton wax cords, and other handicraft products. It serves wholesalers and retailers, companies dealing in craft business, craft stores and large retail chain stores, and online business companies. The company also exports its products. Banaras Beads Limited was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Varanasi, India.

stocks.name: Bharat Dynamics Limited
stocks.desc: Bharat Dynamics Limited manufactures and sells guided missiles, underwater weapons, air-borne products, and allied defense equipment in India. The company offers light weight torpedoes, Varunastra or heavy-weight torpedoes, medium-range surface-to-air missile, dishani, quick reaction surface-to-air missile, multi-influential ground mines, vertically launched-short range surface-to-air missile, flame, Konkurs launcher test equipment, Akash and Astra weapon systems, Konkurs missile test equipment, anti-submarine warfare suite, counter measures dispensing system, smart anti-airfield weapon, anti-torpedo decoy launching system, Helina, Amogha, man portable ATGM, NAG ATGM, Invar, Konkurs-M ATGM, Milan2T ATGM, and unified launchers. It also exports its products. Bharat Dynamics Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

stocks.name: Birla Precision Technologies Limited
stocks.desc: Birla Precision Technologies Limited manufactures and sells machine tools and accessories, precision and automotive components, and castings in India, Japan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Tooling, Automotive Components, and Other segments. The company offers tool holders, including collet, side lock, milling, shrink fit, dual taper, special, stub, extra gauge length, morse taper, turning tool, and mechanical holders; work and tool holding products; hydraulic and power grip milling chucks; production boosters; wooden box kits; boring bar adapters; jacobs tapers; drill chuck adapters; tapping systems; VDI shank tooling; reduction sleeves; shrink-fit heating machines; collets; and accessories. It also provides cutting tools comprising solid carbide drills, solid carbide end mills, twist and center drills, reamers, bore and shank type milling cutters, screwing taps, tools bits, engineering files, and grooving tools, as well as duratool products, consisting of hammer, masonry, and H series drills; annular cutters; carbide tip drills; steel files; ultra-thin and chopsaw wheels; depressed center discs; and TCT circular saws. In addition, the company offers ferrous shell casting products, such as bearing and turbine housings; braking; engine parts; fuel system shafts; o-ring carriers; drive shafts; end parts for metallic bellows; flanges; hydraulic spools; hydraulic actuator cylinders; rocker arm levers; halter; end yokes; crank shafts; fork selectors; machinery application; and turbocharger components for railways. It sells its products under the Dagger, Hathyar, Ninja, Panther and Carbomach brands. The company exports its products to Japan, Germany, the Czech Republic, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company was formerly known as Birla Kennametal Limited and changed its name to Birla Precision Technologies Limited in November 2007. Birla Precision Technologies Limited was founded in 1937 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: BEML Land Assets Limited
stocks.desc: BEML Land Assets Limited engages in real estate business in India. It leases out properties in Bangalore and Mysore. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited
stocks.desc: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of LED lighting and allied products in India. It provides LED focus lights, plastic body panel lights, surface lights, down lights, and AC street lights, as well as flashlights and solar lights. The company's products are used in various applications, such as commercial, residential, government offices, corridor lightings, arterial roads, main roads, multi-level junctions, traffic round-about, civic centers, etc. In addition, it is involved in work contracts. The company was formerly known as Artemis Electricals Limited and changed its name to Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited in August 2021. Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Thane, India.

stocks.name: Airo Lam Limited
stocks.desc: Airo Lam Limited engages in the production, processing, and marketing of decorative laminate sheets and plywood in India. The company offers decorative laminates, decorative postforming, I Lam, I lite, color code laminates, and classico products; specialty laminates, including anti fingerprint, dura gloss pro, chalk grade, marker grade, synchronized, metallic, flicker, and digital laminates; and performance laminates, such as electrostatic dissipative, fire retardant, chemical resistant, and magnetic laminates. It also provides exterior and interior wall cladding, and restroom and cubicle laminates; plywood, blockboards, and flush door airoply products; gloss and matte acrylic panels; and matte finish products. The company sells its products through a network of distributors and dealers. It exports its products to Singapore, Malaysia, the United States, the United Kingdom, Kuwait, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Syria, Iran, Egypt, Nepal, and Vietnam. Airo Lam Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Prantij, India.

stocks.name: The Anup Engineering Limited
stocks.desc: The Anup Engineering Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering products in India and internationally. The company is also involved in manufacturing and fabrication of process equipment. In addition, it offers static process equipment, including heat exchangers, reactors, pressure vessels, columns and towers, and custom fabrication products; technology products, such as helix changers, EMBaffle heat exchangers, and polymerization reactors; and industrial centrifuges, as well as pre-fabrication engineering services for static process equipment. The company serves oil and gas, petrochemicals, LNG, fertilisers, chemicals, power, hydrogen, water, paper and pulp, aerospace, and other industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Anveshan Heavy Engineering Limited and changed its name to The Anup Engineering Limited in January 2019. The Anup Engineering Limited was founded in 1962 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: A-One Steels India Limited
stocks.desc: A-One Steels India Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of Iron and steel products in India. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: Apollo Pipes Limited
stocks.desc: Apollo Pipes Limited manufactures and trades in polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes and fittings in India. The company offers cPVC, uPVC, and PPR-C plumbing systems; uPVC pressure pipes and fittings, and garden pipes; HDPE PLB duct pipes and MDPE and HDPE gas piping system; SWR drainage system, underground drainage system, and DWC pipes; and agri pipes and fitting, HDPE pipes, coils, and sprinkler systems. It also provides underground drainage uPVC column Pipes, and casing pipes; water tanks, solvent cement, and kitchen sink. In addition, the company offers bath fittings, which include faucets, showers, health faucets, cistern, seat covers, accessories, and allied products. It provides its products to plumbing, agriculture, sewerage, water management, construction, fenestration industry, infrastructure, borewell system solutions, water storage solutions, water supply solutions, bath fittings solutions, industrial piping solutions, and telecom ducting industries. Apollo Pipes Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

stocks.name: Assam Entrade Limited
stocks.desc: Assam Entrade Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company trades in shares and securities, mutual fund units, debentures, and bonds; offers loans and advances; and develops integrated residential townships. It is also involved in the real estate activities, as well as acts as a real estate agent. The company serves body corporates, individuals, and other entities. Assam Entrade Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Kanpur, India.

stocks.name: Carborundum Universal Limited
stocks.desc: Carborundum Universal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells abrasives, ceramics, and electrominerals in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Surface Engineering, Technical Ceramics and Super Refractory Solutions, and Electrominerals. The company offers super, bonded and coated abrasives, cutting and grinding, metal working fluids, and power tools; and electro minerals, such as alumina, carbides, zirconia; and thermal spray and ceramic powders. It also provides industrial ceramics for applications in mining and mineral processing, power and energy systems, mobility, semiconductors and electronics, and aerospace and defense; and dense refractories, including bricks and engineered shapes, insulating, and range of monolithic refractories, pre-cast pre-fired components, acid-resistant liners comprising carbon bricks, advanced composites, specialty screeding and coatings, polymer concrete cells, and structural composites, including piping for abrasion resistance; and graphene, phase change materials, high-purity silicon carbide, and specialty polymers. In addition, the company offers IT infrastructure facility management, software application development, remote infrastructure management, and IT security management services; and operates gas-based power generation facility. Carborundum Universal Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Asian Granito India Limited
stocks.desc: Asian Granito India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and trade of tiles, marbles, and allied products in India and internationally. The company offers floor, wall, and parking tiles; glazed and polished vitrified tiles; countertops; quartz and marble surfaces; sanitary ware comprising showers, water closets, basins, urinals, cisterns, and seat covers; bath ware; CP fittings; faucets and construction chemicals. It distributes its products through a network of dealers and sub-dealers, retail touchpoints, display centers, and franchisee showrooms. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: Bharat Bijlee Limited
stocks.desc: Bharat Bijlee Limited operates as an electrical engineering company in India and internationally. It operates through Power Systems and Industrial Systems segments. The company is involved in the design, manufacture, commission, and marketing of power transformers; EPC projects for electrical substations, such as delivery, rectification, commissioning, and servicing of transformers; and marketing of maintenance products. It also develops, manufactures, and markets a range of standard and customized electric motors, including low and medium voltage motors, and SynchroVERT IE4 motors; and magnet technology machines, such as gearless belt machines for passenger lift, home elevators, and heavy-duty goods. In addition, the company engineers and supplies drives and automation systems, which include AC and Servo drive, and motion controllers. Further, the company undertakes turnkey projects, including switchyards. Bharat Bijlee Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Beta Drugs Limited
stocks.desc: Beta Drugs Limited develops, manufactures, and sells anti-cancer bulk drugs and finished dosages in India. The company offers cosmeceutical and oncology products. It also manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and pharmaceutical formulation intermediates (PFI). The company exports its products. Beta Drugs Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Panchkula, India.

stocks.name: Biocon Limited
stocks.desc: Biocon Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures biotechnology products and offers research services in India, the United States, Ireland, rest of the European Union, and internationally. It operates through Generics; Biosimilars; and Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) segments. The company offers generic formulations and API products, including cardiovascular, anti-diabetics, obesity, central nervous system, anti-cancer/oncology, multiple sclerosis, immunosuppressants, and specialty molecules; and biosimilars products for oncology, diabetes, and immunology therapeutic areas. It also provides integrated discovery, development, and manufacturing services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical industries, as well as academic institutions, non-profit organizations, and government agencies. In addition, the company offers enzyme, biopharmaceutical, and medicinal goods; contract research and manufacturing services; clinical research; and business support and development, and marketing services. Biocon Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Limited
stocks.desc: Capital Small Finance Bank Limited provides a range of banking and financial products and services for individuals and businesses in India. It operates through four segments: Treasury, Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations. The company offers various deposits accounts, including savings, current, cumulative, short term, quarterly and monthly interest deposit and recurring deposits; real estate regulatory authority accounts; term deposits; bank lockers; debit and credit cards; trade finance; bank guarantees; 3-in-1 trading account; ATMs; cheque and pass books; and pension scheme. It also provides loans, such as loan against rentals, auto, housing, gold, personal, mortgage loan against property, credit card for farmer, corporate loan, and MSME loans. In addition, the company offers various insurance products, such as general, life, health, travel, home, and motor. Further, it provides money transfer, bill payment system, payment gateway, net banking, tax payments, and foreign exchange, government banking, NRI banking services and point of sale services. The company was formerly known as Capital Local Area Bank Limited and changed its name to Capital Small Finance Bank Limited in April 2016. Capital Small Finance Bank Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Jalandhar, India.

stocks.name: Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited
stocks.desc: Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates, and specialty chemicals for various industrial applications in India. The company offers intermediates, including mono methyl urea, di methyl urea, ortho para nitro anisole, 2-bromomethyl-1,3-dioxolane, and uracil. It also provides active pharmaceutical ingredients, such as metformin HCl, mefenamic acid, and doxofylline. In addition, the company trades chemicals and solvents, including aromatic chemicals, chemical acids, chlor-alkali, chlorinated solvent, glycols and glycol ethers, fiber intermediates, and acetates and esters, as well as industrial alcohols, ketones, amines, oleochemicals, intermediates, olefins, phosphates, fertilizers, monomers, and chemicals. Further, it offers lumefantrine; nimesulide; albendazole; carbamazepine; and oxcarbazepine. It serves pharmaceutical formulation manufacturers and pharmaceutical merchant exporters. Aarey Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: ABM International Limited
stocks.desc: ABM International Limited engages in the importing and trading of plastic raw materials in India. The company sells PVC resins, finished leather products, DOP, urea, etc. ABM International Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited
stocks.desc: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited engages in the human resource and recruitment businesses in India. It operates through four segments: Examination and Related IT Services; Printing and Paper Sales; Specialty Chemicals; and Property and Related Services. The company offers manpower recruitment and training services, including workforce planning, advertisement management, application management, pre-employment screening, candidate profiling, psychometric assessments, recruitment assessment, recruitment assessment, candidate management, and recruitment analytics support; and examination management solutions, such as designing application, candidate authentication, result preparation, question paper management, examination conduction, result finalization, candidate support helpdesk, answer sheet scanning, and result handover. It also provides iOS and Android app development; custom and CMS website development, as well as e-commerce solutions; and extension of time assessments, delay and disruption reviews, project planning and controls, BIM coordination, contract administration, claims management, risk assessment, and project legal support. In addition, the company is involved in CAD and BIM drafting services; architecture, construction, and engineering solutions; and import and export of inks and primers. It serves the commission, defense, education, and PSU markets. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Asian Hotels (West) Limited
stocks.desc: Asian Hotels (West) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the hotel business in India. The company owns and operates the Hotel Hyatt Regency in Mumbai; and the JW Marriott Hotel, a five-star deluxe hotel in New Delhi. It also develops, designs, finances, constructs, operates, and maintains hotel properties. The company was formerly known as Chillwinds Hotels Limited and changed its name to Asian Hotels (West) Limited in February 2010. Asian Hotels (West) Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: AKG Exim Limited
stocks.desc: AKG Exim Limited engages in the commodity trading business in India and rest of Asia. The company distributes agro-food commodities comprising basmati and non-basmati rice, spices, and dry fruits; ferrous scraps, such as heavy and light melting, cast iron, auto purja, iron pipes, and stainless-steel products. It also offers non-ferrous scraps, including magnesium, aluminum tense, taint and tabor, taldon, copper, brass, and lead battery; petrochemicals, which include base oil, sulphur granules, urea, bitumen, aromatics, alkyl benzene, toluene, and other petroleum-based chemicals; and reusable items. In addition, the company provides engineering, technical and business consultancy, indenting/commission, international supply, sourcing, and product establishment services. Further, it exports its products. AKG Exim Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.

stocks.name: AMD Industries Limited
stocks.desc: AMD Industries Limited provides packaging solutions in India and internationally. The company offers various types of crown caps, including PVC spun, moulded, and dry blend crown caps; double lip liner CSD closures; pet preforms; pet bottles; jars; and plastic bottles. It serves food and beverages, home care, personal care, liquor and spirits, paints and adhesives, pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, dairy, automotive, and agrochemicals industries. AMD Industries Limited was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: BEML Limited
stocks.desc: BEML Limited provides products and services to the mining and construction, rail and metro, power, and defense and aerospace sectors in India. The company offers high mobility vehicles, combat mobility vehicles, 1500 horsepower engines, aggregates for combat vehicles, aircraft towing tractors, aircraft weapon loaders, ground support and handling equipment, tank transportation trailers, milrail wagons, rocket motor casings for missiles, airborne structures and assemblies, and construction equipment for the defense and aerospace industries. It also provides bulldozers, dump trucks, excavators, shovels/walking dragline, water sprinklers, motor graders, loaders, pipe layers, wheeled dozers, and tyre handlers to the mining and construction industries. In addition, the company offers metro cars, electrical multiple units, maintenance vehicles, passenger trains, steel and aluminum wagons, and treasury vans to the rail and metro industries. Further, it exports its products. The company was formerly known as Bharat Earth Movers Limited. BEML Limited was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: Bhartiya International Ltd.
stocks.desc: Bhartiya International Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades in leather and textile products in India. The company offers leather outerwear, bags, accessories, belts, wallets, fur products, and other small leather goods, as well as textile apparel, knitted and woven garments, sleepwear, puffers, jackets, non-leather bags, leather finishing; and design studio services. It also engages in the development of cities, homes, IT and industrial parks, retail spaces, interior solutions, and hotels and convention centers. The company exports its products. Bhartiya International Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Gurugram, India.

stocks.name: Aavas Financiers Limited
stocks.desc: Aavas Financiers Limited provides housing finance services to low- and middle-income customers in semi-urban and rural areas in India. The company offers home loans for flats, houses, and bungalows; home construction loans for residential houses; resale property purchase loans, and home improvement loans, including loans for tiling or flooring, plaster or painting, etc. It also provides loans against property; micro, small, and medium enterprise loans; and home loan balance transfer, as well as cash salaried plus loans and small ticket size loans. The company was formerly known as AU Housing Finance Limited and changed its name to Aavas Financiers Limited in May 2017. Aavas Financiers Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Jaipur, India.

stocks.name: Aequs Limited
stocks.desc: Aequs Limited, a contract manufacturing company, engages in the provision of integrated products solutions in India, the United States of America, France, Hong Kong, Sweden, United Kingdom, Germany, and internationally. It operates through Aerospace and Consumer segments. The company operates a fully vertically integrated aerospace manufacturing value chain that offers end-to-end manufacturing and integration solutions, such as forging, precision machining, surface engineering, and aero structure assembly. It also manufactures aluminum non-stick and ceramic coating cookware, triply cookware and triply cooker, kitchenware and houseware including cookware, bakeware utensils, cutlery and cutting boards; consumer electronic products comprising of components for portable computers and smart devices; as well as plastic products such as outdoor games/darts, toy vehicles, figures, dolls, role play toys and STEM toys. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Belagavi, India.

stocks.name: Arman Financial Services Limited
stocks.desc: Arman Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiary, operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company offers micro, small, and medium enterprise loans; two wheeler financing for motorcycles, mopeds, scooterettes, and scooters; and micro finance loans, as well as individual business loans and loan against property. The company was formerly known as Arman Lease and Finance Limited and changed its name to Arman Financial Services Limited in November 2008. Arman Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: Atam Valves Limited
stocks.desc: Atam Valves Limited manufactures and sells valves, fittings, steam traps, and strainers in India, Nepal, Italy, Canada, the United Kingdom, Malaysia, South Africa, Dubai, and internationally. The company offers cocks and boiler mountings; moisture separators; sight indicators; steam traps; strainers; water level gauges; fusible plugs; air, ball, butterfly, check, foot, gate, globe, needle, non-return, parallel slide blow off, plug, pressure reducing, safety, steam stop, and wheel valves gauges; drop forged stainless steel needle valve, and screwed ends; and sight flow. It serves the oil and gas refinery, petrochemical, power generation plant, boiler manufacturing, power transformer manufacturing, sugar, textile, rubber, pharmaceutical, chemical, fertilizer, paper, processing, marine and ship building, infrastructure and household, and plumbing industries. The company sells its products under the ATAM and FEBI brands through dealers. Atam Valves Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Jalandhar, India.

stocks.name: AUGMONT ENTERPRISES LTD
stocks.desc: Augmont Enterprises Limited operates as an integrated gold and silver platform in India. It engages in procurement and refining, bullion trading, digital gold offerings, jewellery manufacturing, international sales and facilitating gold-backed financial services. The company operates its enterprise sales vertical through its Augmont SPOT' platform, a fully electronic, over-the-counter delivery-based bullion platform that enables such as jewelers, bullion dealers, and manufacturers with valid GST registrations to purchase gold and silver bars online. It is also involved in the sale of gold bullion to asset management companies in exchange for units of gold exchange traded funds (ETF) and trade in gold and silver ETF units. In addition, the company manufactures and sells gold jewelry articles, which include chains to jewelry traders, as well as platinum. Further, it serves consumers through its Augmont Gold For All' platform by offering access to a range of gold and silver related services. The company's platform enables users to buy, sell, and store gold and silver digitally; purchase gold through systematic investment plans; liquidate and sell old gold; purchase coins starting from 1 gm; and avail technology support for gold loans. Augmont Enterprises Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited
stocks.desc: Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited engages in the international wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical products across various therapeutic areas, including antibiotics, analgesic, anti-malaria, and others. It also provides biscuits and toothpaste. The company was formerly known as Balaxi Ventures Limited and changed its name to Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited in October 2020. The company was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India. Balaxi Pharmaceuticals Limited is a subsidiary of Balaxi Overseas Private Limited.

stocks.name: Bonlon Industries Limited
stocks.desc: Bonlon Industries Limited manufactures and trades in ferrous and non-ferrous metals in India and internationally. It operates through Metal, Trading, and Manufacturing segments. The company offers copper wire rods for use in electrical and other engineering industries; and copper wires for use in power generation and transmission, power distribution, telecommunication, electronic circuitry, and electrical equipment applications, as well as offers cathode, ingots, and cables. It also deals in copper, aluminum, zinc, lead, nickel, etc.; and manufactures plastic insulated power cables. It also exports its cable products primarily to the United Arab Emirates and Nigeria. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Cipla Limited
stocks.desc: Cipla Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, develops, sells, and distributes pharmaceutical products in India, the United States, South Africa, and internationally. It offers generic and branded generic medicines, vaccines, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and formulations for various therapeutic areas, such as MI, angina, heart disease, pulmonary disease, kidney disorders, alzheimer's disease, hypertension, arrhythmia, lipid abnormalities and diabetes, obesity, central nervous system, HIV/AIDS, respiratory, asthma, urology, oncology, cardio-metabolism, child health, infectious diseases and critical care, hepatitis, women's health, ophthalmology, and neuro psychiatry. The company is also involved in the consumer healthcare, biosimilars, and specialty businesses. Cipla Limited was incorporated in 1935 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Agri-tech (India) Limited
stocks.desc: Agri-Tech (India) Limited engages in horticulture business in India. It primarily cultivates mangoes. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Alpa Laboratories Limited
stocks.desc: Alpa Laboratories Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of drugs and chemicals in India. It offers ethical, generic, and over the counter medicines. The company provides tablets, capsules, injections, syrups, ointments, creams, eye drops, and other dosage forms for human and veterinary healthcare, as well as aquaculture products, including probiotics, deodorizer, minerals, feed supplements, and disinfectant. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Indore, India.

stocks.name: Amal Ltd
stocks.desc: Amal Ltd manufactures and markets bulk chemicals in India. It offers oleum, sulphuric acid, Sulphur dioxide, and Sulphur trioxide for use in dyestuff, fertilizer, personal care, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and textile industries. The company was formerly known as Amal Products Limited and changed its name to Amal Ltd in September 2003. Amal Ltd was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Amber Enterprises India Limited
stocks.desc: Amber Enterprises India Limited engages in the room air conditioners (RAC) industry in India. It offers complete built units and various components for consumer durable goods; room air conditioners, such as split AC, outdoor unit, window AC, and top-throw window AC; and commercial air conditioners, including cassette AC, tower AC, duct, VRF, water heat pump, and outdoor unit. The company also provides components comprising heat exchangers, sheet metal component, copper tubing, cross flow and axial fans, plastic moulding, tooling, and motors; and electronics manufacturing services consisting of PCBA, PCBs, power electronics, and industrial automation for automotive, telecom, consumer electronics, lighting, industrial power electronics, space and defence, EMS, entertainment, and other industries. In addition, it offers railway and metro subsystems, which include HVAC, gangways, doors, pantry systems, brakes, coupler, pantograph, driving gear, switchboard cabinet, cab booster units, feeder junction box, and microcontroller; railway and metro, buses, heavy equipment, and defence HVAC systems; and data center perimeter cooling, in-rack cooling, in-row cooling, panel cooling, battery and UPS room AC, precision split AC, telecom shelter 2in1 AC, and ductable ACs. Further, the company exports its products. Amber Enterprises India Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Gurugram, India.

stocks.name: Ashika Global Securities Limited
stocks.desc: Ashika Global Securities Limited provides investment and lending solutions in India. It provides loans and advances, loans against securities, inter-corporate deposits, and investment in shares and securities. The company also offers retail broking; lending; investment banking; global family office services; alternative investment funds; research advisory; institutional broking; private equity services; and insurance and insurance related services. It serves individuals, corporates, and financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Ashika Credit Capital Limited and changed its name to Ashika Global Securities Limited in January 2026. Ashika Global Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Allcargo Terminals Limited
stocks.desc: Allcargo Terminals Limited operates container freight stations (CFS) and logistics business in India and internationally. It provides import and export handling; bonded, non-bonded, and open warehousing; direct port delivery; hazardous cargo; cargo handling; reefer container; ISO tank; and last mile transportation services. Allcargo Terminals Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: B.A.G. Films and Media Limited
stocks.desc: B.A.G. Films and Media Limited engages in content production, distribution, and allied activities in India. The company operates through Audio -Visual Production; Leasing; FM Radio; F.M. Radio Podcast; Television Broadcasting Content Syndication; and Television Broadcasting segments. It operates News24, a 24-hour national Hindi news channel; E24, a 24-hour entertainment channel; and FM radio stations under the Dhamaal24 brand. The company also provides infrastructural support for content production. B.A.G. Films and Media Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Noida, India.

stocks.name: Bajaj Steel Industries Limited
stocks.desc: Bajaj Steel Industries Limited manufactures and sells cotton ginning and pressing machinery in India. The company provides industrial conveyors, HVAC systems, fire-fighting solutions, steel doors, hydraulic systems, and turnkey engineering services, as well as prefabricated building structure, heavy engineering products, firefighting, doors, electrical panels, conveyors components, and allied products. It also offers fire alarm and detection systems, fire extinguishers, and fire hydrant pumps; steel doors; fire-rated doors; industrial fans; hydraulics solutions; specialty conveyors; duct systems and cyclone solution laser cutting machines; and trades cotton and power transmission products. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.

stocks.name: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited
stocks.desc: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited, an investment company, provides financial services in India. It operates through Financing, Insurance, and Others segments. The company offers vehicle finance, loans against property, home loans, secured business and personal loans, consumer and small enterprises loans, gold loans, and small and medium enterprise loans, as well as various other financial services to customers; and general insurance services, including motor, property and casualty, health, accident, fire and engineering, crop, marine, and travel insurance, as well as reinsurance. It serves first-time borrowers, new to credit customers, and individuals, as well as corporates, small, micro, medium enterprises. The company was formerly known as TI Financial Holdings Limited and changed its name to Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited in March 2019. Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited
stocks.desc: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited, a housing finance company, engages in the housing finance business in India. The company offers loans for residential property; plot purchase and construction; home improvement and extension loans; commercial property construction and acquisition; and loans against residential properties. It serves individuals, companies, corporations, societies, and association of persons. The company was formerly known as DHFL Vysya Housing Finance Limited and changed its name to Aadhar Housing Finance Limited in August 2017. Aadhar Housing Finance Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aadhar Housing Finance Limited is a subsidiary of Bcp Asia Ii Holdco Vii Pte. Ltd.

stocks.name: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited
stocks.desc: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited provides stock brokerage services in India and internationally. The company offers equities, derivatives, alternative investment funds, IPOs, mutual funds, portfolio management services, investment basket, margin trading facility, NRI investing, commodities, currencies, fixed income, and insurance products. It also provides TradeMobi, an online app for trading and account related services; TradeXpress, a web-based platform to execute trades and access real-time market data; AR Invest; and Algozy for algorithmic trading strategies. The company was formerly known as Navratan Capital and Securities Limited and changed its name to Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited in January 2008. Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India. Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited operates as a subsidiary of Anand Rathi Financial Services Limited.

stocks.name: Avance Technologies Limited
stocks.desc: Avance Technologies Limited engages in the dealing of IT products in India. The company offers digital infrastructure, embedded device management, hybrid infrastructure, internet of things infrastructure management, data center management and optimization, as well as cloud integration and management. It serves healthcare, finance, retail, manufacturing, and hospitality industries. The company was formerly known as VMC Software Ltd. Avance Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Baid Finserv Limited
stocks.desc: Baid Finserv Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company provides car, new and used commercial vehicle, gold, small and medium enterprises, tractors, construction equipment, and other asset backed loans, as well as loan against property. It also offers life, dwelling, and motor insurance products. The company was formerly known as Baid Leasing and Finance Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Baid Finserv Limited in July 2022. Baid Finserv Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Jaipur, India.

stocks.name: Aditya Birla Money Limited
stocks.desc: Aditya Birla Money Limited provides financial services in India. The company operates through three segments: Broking, Wholesale Debt Market, and Others. It offers stock and commodity broking; portfolio management services; depository and e-insurance repository solutions; and various financial products, as well as research and investment advisory services. The company was formerly known as Apollo Sindhoori Capital Investments Ltd and changed its name to Aditya Birla Money Limited in August 2009. Aditya Birla Money Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Chennai, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited.

stocks.name: The Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited
stocks.desc: The Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited manufactures and sells polyester staple fibre products in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate, Polyester, and Retail/Textile. It offers polyester staple fibre and specialty products, including micro, optical white, dope dyed black, trilobal, hollow, spun lace, and high tenacity fibers, as well as textile grade PET chips. The company also engages in the retail of textiles and home furnishings; and development of real estate properties, such as residences, offices, hotels, serviced apartments, hospitals, schools, and retail. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1879 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Capri Global Capital Limited
stocks.desc: Capri Global Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial services in India. It offers home loans; micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSME) loans; construction finance; small business loans; loans against property; and gold loans, as well as indirect lending, car loan distribution, and insurance distribution services. The company was formerly known as Money Matters Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Capri Global Capital Limited in July 2013. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: ACME Solar Holdings Limited
stocks.desc: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, a solar independent power producing company, engages in the develops, constructs, owns, operates, and maintains grid-connected renewable energy projects in India. The company owns and operates solar and wind energy projects with a total installed capacity of 2,982 MW; and 1,324 MWh of battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. It is also developing and constructing solar and wind energy projects with a total capacity of 2,850 MW; and 12 GWh of BESS projects. In addition, the company is involved in the firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE)/hybird projects. Further, it provides engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as operation and maintenance services. It serves central and state government-backed entities, and government-backed corporations. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Gurugram, India. ACME Solar Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of ACME Cleantech Solutions Limited.

stocks.name: Archidply Decor Limited
stocks.desc: Archidply Decor Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of wood-based products in India and internationally. The company provides decorative laminates, decorative veneers, plywood and block board, and pre-laminated particle boards. It also provides Gurjan based plywood, Pureply plywood, Bon Vivant, particle board & MDF, as well as decorative veneered and plain flush doors. Archidply Decor Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

stocks.name: ArMee Infotech Limited
stocks.desc: ArMee Infotech Limited provides IT Infrastructure solutions and IT managed services for Government, PSUs, BFSI, education, and private sectors in India. It offers IT Infrastructure products, such as computers, servers, interactive panels and their peripherals; IT managed services, installation and integration of IT hardware and software products; Renewable Energy Space, such as renewable energy EPC services, renewable energy Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) services, renewable energy Battery Energy Storage System (BESS); and experience zones, engages in selling IT hardware and consumer goods, including computers and computer peripherals, consumer electricals, gaming products, and electronics. It also offers cyber-security solutions, including firewall, antivirus, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and encryption services; technical manpower; skill development training; annual maintenance services onsite and off-site operational support; and IT infrastructure maintenance services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited
stocks.desc: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of real estate projects in India. The company develops residential, commercial, industrial projects, villa townships, apartments, plotted developments and villas, commercial spaces, and industrial parks. It serves individual retail clients and corporate entities. The company was formerly known as Arvind Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Arvind SmartSpaces Limited in November 2016. Arvind SmartSpaces Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

stocks.name: Atlantaa Limited
stocks.desc: Atlantaa Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in India. The company undertakes development of highways, expressways, and arterial roads, as well as railway projects; and constructing airport infrastructures. It is also involved in Infrastructure development; engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contracts; public, private partnership (PPP Model on build operate and transfer (BOT) and design, build, finance, operate and transfer (DBFOT) basis; and infrastructure development activities, such as inter-alia, construction of road, bridges, and runways. In addition, the company engages in the real estate development comprising residential, retail, and commercial. The company was formerly known as Atlanta Limited and changed its name to Atlantaa Limited in September 2023. Atlantaa Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Bajel Projects Limited
stocks.desc: Bajel Projects Limited engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) for power transmission and distribution projects in India and internationally. The company offers turnkey solutions, including engineering, designing, testing, manufacturing, executing, and commissioning of EHV transmission lines; and constructs new infrastructure, as well as the augmentation of existing infrastructure for various power distribution companies and agencies.
