It offers natural stone granite slabs and granite tiles; and engineered quartz stone slabs for construction, home renovation, wall panelling, countertops, flooring, interior surfaces, and architectural installations. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries, including the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, the Far East, and South Pacific countries. Aro Granite Industries Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Hosur, India.

stocks.name: Arshiya Limited
stocks.desc: Arshiya Limited provides integrated supply chain and logistics infrastructure solutions in India. The company operates in two segments, Free Trade Warehousing Zones (FTWZ)/Special Economic Zone (SEZ) and Domestic Warehousing. It develops and operates FTWZs that include integrated logistics infrastructure comprising storage areas, material handling equipment, container yards, inland container depot, customs offices, and commercial complex. The company also offers third-party logistics and other value optimization services, such as handling and transportation, packaging, consolidation, palletization, labelling, kitting, bagging, bottling, cutting-slitting, survey, quality assurance, refurbishment, repairs and maintenance, washing, etc. In addition, it provides infrastructure and freight services. The company was formerly known as Arshiya International Limited and changed its name to Arshiya Limited in September 2013. Arshiya Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Bharat Coking Coal Limited
stocks.desc: Bharat Coking Coal Limited produces and sells coal in India. The company offers coking coal, non-coking coal, and washed coking and power coal products, as well as rejects and slurries. Its products are used in power, steel, cement, fertilizer, and glass manufacturing applications. The company serves the power and non-power sectors. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Dhanbad, India. Bharat Coking Coal Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.

stocks.name: BirlaNu Limited
stocks.desc: BirlaNu Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes home and building products and services in India, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Roofs, Walls, Pipes and Construction Chemicals, Floors, and Others. It offers fiber cement, fortune fiber cement, ultracool fiber cement, and colored steel roofs, as well as leakproof sealing and structural support tools and accessories under the Charminar brand name; AAC blocks, panels, designer cement boards, and planks under the BirlaNu Aerocon brand name; and CPVC, uPVC, SWR, silent, UGD, foamcore, pressure, column, casing, PPR, HDPE, MDPE, gas pipes, electrofusion fittings, FHTC fittings, and water tanks under the BirlaNu Leakproof Pipes and Topline by BirlaNu Leakproof Pipes brand names. The company also provides wall putty and primer under the BirlaNu TruColour Putty and BirlaNu Primers brand names; bonding agents, waterproofing solutions, tile adhesives and grouts, epoxy and polyurethane coatings, anti-corrosion linings, and block joining mortars under the BirlaNu brand name; and laminates, engineered and resilient floorings, skirtings, and wall panels under the Parador brand name. In addition, it engages in wind power generation; and manufacturing of material handling and processing plant and equipment. The company was formerly known as HIL Limited and changed its name to BirlaNu Limited in March 2025. BirlaNu Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Centrum Capital Limited
stocks.desc: Centrum Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services for institutions and individuals in India. It operates through Banking Business; Institutional Business; Wealth Management & Distribution; and Housing Finance Business segments. The company offers investment banking services, including equity initial public offerings (IPO), follow-on public offerings and rights issues, pre-IPO placements, qualified institutional placements, American depository receipts, global depository receipts, alternative investment markets, convertible issuances, buybacks and delisting, open offers, and valuation advisory services; working capital, project finance, term/corporate loans, and external commercial borrowings/foreign currency loans; and mergers and acquisitions, structured finance advisory, and private equity advisory services, as well as infrastructure advisory services. It also provides home and non-home loans; distribution services, tax and financial planning, family legacy and leadership, philanthropy, trust and estate, and ancillary services; corporate treasury services; stock broking services; general, travel, health, and life insurance services; private credit and venture debt funding services; and portfolio and wealth management, and retail broking services. In addition, the company offers institutional equities and research services, as well as trades in bonds. Further, it offers MSME loans and micro finance services. Centrum Capital Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Brand Concepts Limited
stocks.desc: Brand Concepts Limited manufactures and retails bags, travel gear, and fashion accessories in India and internationally. It offers travel gears, such as luggage trolleys, backpacks, business cases, overnighter, crossbody, duffels/gym bags, messenger bags, reporter and rucksacks, gift sets, and reporter bags; clutches, wallets, totes, satchels, and handbags for women; and small leather goods for men comprising belts and wallets, as well as socks under the Superdry, Juicy Couture, Off White, Tommy Hilfiger Travel Gear, United Colors of Benetton, Sugarush, Aeropostale, and The Vertical brands. The company sells its products through brand outlets, bagline stores, large-format retailers, multi-brand outlets, institutional sales and leading e-commerce platforms, including Bagline.com. Brand Concepts Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Indore, India.

stocks.name: Bharat Road Network Limited
stocks.desc: Bharat Road Network Limited operates as a Build Operate-Transfer (BOT) company that owns, designs, develops, builds, operates, and transfers road and related services in India. It also engages in the development, implementation, operation, and maintenance of road and highway projects. In addition, the company provides project development and implementation; tolling operation and maintenance; highway management and development; claim and contracts management; and advisory and project management services, including construction supervision/debt syndication. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Kolkata, India.

stocks.name: Anik Industries Limited
stocks.desc: Anik Industries Limited trades in agri-commodities and edible oils in India. It operates through Real Estate and Trading segments. The company is involved in trading and merchandising agri-commodities, such as cotton, oilseeds, grains, pulses, spices, wheat, sesame seeds, corn, rice, cumin seeds, gram, and various agro based products; operating conventional, solar, wind, small and mini hydel, and biomass power plant; and construction and development of housing projects and properties. It also engages in mining natural resources, coal, manganese, and phosphate rock deposits; involved in real estate projects; and offers integrated ferro alloys for use in steel making. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Madhya Pradesh Glychem Industries Limited and changed its name to Anik Industries Limited in September 2006. Anik Industries Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Indore, India.

stocks.name: ARCL Organics Ltd.
stocks.desc: ARCL Organics Ltd. manufactures and sells resins, additives, hardeners, and specialized one-shot resins in India. The company offers amino and melamine resins, phenolic resins, and formaldehydes. It serves panel, animal feed, rubber, pharma, engineering, textile, paper, foundries, refractories, paints, tire, and various other industries. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as AAREM Chemicals (P) Ltd. and changed its name to ARCL Organics Ltd. in April 2011. ARCL Organics Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Kolkata, India.

stocks.name: BIL Vyapar Limited
stocks.desc: BIL Vyapar Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the provision of media and publication services. The company was formerly known as Binani Industries Limited and changed its name to BIL Vyapar Limited in June 2025. BIL Vyapar Limited was founded in 1872 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Blue Chip India Limited
stocks.desc: Blue Chip India Limited provides inter corporate deposits in India. It also invests in equity and preference shares, mutual and alternative investment funds, corporate deposits and loans to corporate bodies and individuals. Blue Chip India Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Kolkata, India.

stocks.name: Allcargo Global Limited
stocks.desc: Allcargo Global Limited operates as a logistics company in India and internationally. The company engages in non-vessel operating common carriers in less-than-container load logistics; and operation of the ECU360, an end-to-end LCL digital platform. It also provides end-to-end multimodal logistics solutions in LCL, FCL, air freight, and door-to-door services; value-added services, including customs clearance, dangerous goods handling, trucking, and warehousing solutions; and e-commerce and turnkey logistics solutions. The company was formerly known as Allcargo Worldwide Limited and changed its name to Allcargo Global Limited in August 2025. Allcargo Global Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: BPL Limited
stocks.desc: BPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells consumer electronics durable products in India. It offers televisions, washing machines, TV speakers and soundbars, refrigerator, air-conditioner, wireless products, cables and cords, fan, computer networking cables, party speakers, bluetooth neckbands, and headphones and headsets; single, double, and multi-layer printed circuit boards; and medical technologies. The company sells its products under the BPL brand. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Palakkad, India.

stocks.name: Concord Enviro Systems Limited
stocks.desc: Concord Enviro Systems Limited engages in providing water and wastewater treatment, and reuse solutions in India and internationally. It offers effluent treatment plants, sewage treatment plants, anaerobic digesters, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis, membrane bio-reactors, desalination systems, waste heat evaporators, zero liquid discharge solutions, and consolidation of final waste to achieve zero discharge. The company also provides plant operations and maintenance; consumables and spare parts, including decantation, filtration, membrane filtration, sludge treatment, equipment overhaul, and maintenance; and consumables; and rehabilitation and modification services. It serves customers in pharmaceuticals, textiles, chemicals, distillery, food and beverage, automobiles, leachate, steel, textiles, oil and gas, tanneries, cement, paper, paint, electronics, mining and minerals, real estate, and sea water desalination solutions industries. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Arihant Superstructures Limited
stocks.desc: Arihant Superstructures Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. The company develops residential properties, including residences, villas, hospitality and mixed-use developments, and apartments. The company was formerly known as Shaktiman Constructions Limited and changed its name to Arihant Superstructures Limited in August 2009. Arihant Superstructures Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

stocks.name: Advik Capital Limited
stocks.desc: Advik Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in financial activities in India. It operates through three segments: Financing, Trading in Securities, and Manufacturing. The company grants financial loans; and provides ancillary services. It is also involved in trading in securities and shares; provision of gold, property, car, personal, and business loans; and investing fund business. In addition, the company engages in assisting the financial accommodation by way of loans/advances to industrial concerns; and leasing and finance lease operations of purchasing, selling, hiring, and letting of plant and machinery. The company was formerly known as Advik Industries Limited and changed its name to Advik Capital Limited in July 2017. Advik Capital Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Blue Coast Hotels Limited
stocks.desc: Blue Coast Hotels Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the hotel business. The company was formerly known as Blue Coast Hotels and Resorts Ltd. and changed its name to Blue Coast Hotels Limited in October 2009. Blue Coast Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.

stocks.name: Celebrity Fashions Limited
stocks.desc: Celebrity Fashions Limited manufactures and exports garments in India and internationally. The company offers shirts, t-shirts, sweaters, shackets, trousers, shorts, and denims for men and boys under the Indian Terrain brand. It sells its products through exclusive stores, multi-brand outlets, and e-commerce stores. Celebrity Fashions Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited
stocks.desc: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited offers engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) and facility management services in India and internationally. it operates through the Engineering Services (ES), Facility Management Services, Municipal Solid Waste Management, and Others segments. The company provides EPC solutions, including distribution, transmissions, substation, feeder renovation, rural and railway electrification, IT application, renewable energy generation, and telecom EPC services; facility management services comprising technical, front office management, vendor management, and facilities management consulting services; facility management home services, such as professional pest control, upholstery shampooing, electric professionals, AC service and repair, plumbing professionals, professional carpenters, honing and polishing of floor, and painter services; and municipal solid waste management services. It also develops the Ecotech green and Bus Shelter-cum-green toilet; bricks made from municipal solid wastes under the Magic Brick name; and a bicycle under the E-Hiran name. In addition, the company engages in renewable energy generation. The company was formerly known as A2Z Maintenance & Engineering Services Limited and changed its name to A2Z Infra Engineering Limited in October 2014. A2Z Infra Engineering Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Gurugram, India.

stocks.name: BGR Energy Systems Limited
stocks.desc: BGR Energy Systems Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells capital equipment for power plants, petrochemical and process industries, and refineries in India and internationally. The company is involved in the provision of turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction services for power plants; supply of sub and super critical steam turbines and generators, and single and multiple pressure level natural circulation heat recovery steam generators; and providing process coolers, finned tubes, radiator and compressors coolers, and tube bundles. It also offers turnkey solutions for EHV substations; optical fiber composite ground wire and optical line termination equipment; gas insulated switchgear substations; EHV transmission lines; plant electrical projects; and rural electrification, as well as power trading and balance of plant works for hydro projects. In addition, the company provides process equipment packages and systems, including phase separator system / skids, indirect water bath heater, gas conditioning, regulating and metering systems, knockout drums / scrubbers, and filter separators / dry gas filters; pipeline equipment; compressor packaging products; and storage tanks; deaerators, membrane based water treatment plant, desalination, demineralization plants, effluent treatment and recycling plants, and condensate polishing units. In addition, it operates thermal power projects at Andhra Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. BGR Energy Systems Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

stocks.name: Burnpur Cement Limited
stocks.desc: Burnpur Cement Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement. Burnpur Cement Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Kolkata, India.
